title: How To Do T-Bar Rows The Right Way
hook: T-bar rows are one of my favorite back exercises. Here's how to do them the right way.
body:
I prefer the chest-supported T-bar row machine. With your chest on the pad, your lower back is protected, and you can't cheat by swinging the weight up with your body.

Take the widest grip possible. Pull the handles to your stomach and squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top. Then lower the weight slowly until your arms are straight and you feel the stretch.

One easy warm-up set of 10 to 15 reps, then two working sets of 8 to 12. Take 2 to 3 seconds on the way down, then explode up.
